manager/planner.name: Planner
manager/planner.mission: Break the requested outcome into ordered tasks.
manager/planner.expected_evidence: A task graph with owners, dependencies, and measurable acceptance criteria.

manager/scheduler.name: Scheduler
manager/scheduler.mission: Order eligible tasks under the single-active-site lock.
manager/scheduler.expected_evidence: A valid execution order with no concurrent site claims.

manager/policy-checker.name: Policy Checker
manager/policy-checker.mission: Check site authorization and task constraints before work.
manager/policy-checker.expected_evidence: Explicit pass/block decision with the policy checks recorded.

manager/state-keeper.name: State Keeper
manager/state-keeper.mission: Validate persisted runtime state and transition consistency.
manager/state-keeper.expected_evidence: State snapshot with no conflicting active-site or invalid transition.

manager/reporter.name: Reporter
manager/reporter.mission: Summarize verified progress and blockers for the manager.
manager/reporter.expected_evidence: Report cites runtime events or artifacts and distinguishes unknowns.

manager/plan-auditor.name: Plan Auditor
manager/plan-auditor.mission: Independently inspect the planner's task graph, dependencies, owners, and acceptance criteria.
manager/plan-auditor.expected_evidence: Audit findings mapped to missing or conflicting requirements.

manager/dependency-auditor.name: Dependency Auditor
manager/dependency-auditor.mission: Independently check scheduler ordering and dependency readiness.
manager/dependency-auditor.expected_evidence: Dependency audit proving no task is dispatched early.

manager/authorization-auditor.name: Authorization Auditor
manager/authorization-auditor.mission: Independently verify policy-checker decisions against site/task permissions.
manager/authorization-auditor.expected_evidence: Recorded allow/block decision and supporting policy evidence.

manager/state-auditor.name: State Auditor
manager/state-auditor.mission: Cross-check persisted state for invalid transitions, duplicate claims, and conflicting locks.
manager/state-auditor.expected_evidence: State consistency report with conflicts identified.

manager/evidence-auditor.name: Evidence Auditor
manager/evidence-auditor.mission: Independently check progress reports against run logs and artifacts.

researcher/source-discovery.name: Source Discovery
researcher/source-discovery.mission: Identify sources explicitly authorized for the active site.
researcher/source-discovery.expected_evidence: Source list with URLs, access scope, and relevance notes.

researcher/analyst.name: Analyst
researcher/analyst.expected_evidence: Prioritized findings with rationale and source references.

researcher/trend-researcher.name: Trend Researcher
researcher/trend-researcher.mission: Assess supported changes or patterns over time.
researcher/trend-researcher.expected_evidence: Time-bounded observations with dates and evidence.

researcher/source-cross-checker.name: Source Cross Checker
researcher/source-cross-checker.mission: Independently check source relevance, accessibility, and authorization.

researcher/claim-verifier.name: Claim Verifier
researcher/claim-verifier.mission: Verify key claims independently against the collected evidence.
researcher/claim-verifier.expected_evidence: Claim/evidence matrix with conflicts and unknowns.

researcher/recommendation-reviewer.name: Recommendation Reviewer
researcher/recommendation-reviewer.mission: Challenge analysis priorities and test whether recommendations follow from evidence.

researcher/trend-verifier.name: Trend Verifier
researcher/trend-verifier.mission: Check time windows, dates, and alternative explanations for trend claims.
researcher/trend-verifier.expected_evidence: Verified trend timeline and uncertainty notes.

researcher/citation-auditor.name: Citation Auditor
researcher/citation-auditor.mission: Audit source links and traceability for the research brief.
researcher/citation-auditor.expected_evidence: Citation completeness report and unsupported-claim list.

image-agent/source-validator.name: Source Validator
image-agent/source-validator.mission: Validate the configured source and allowed usage.
image-agent/source-validator.expected_evidence: Source authorization result and source provenance.

image-agent/asset-preparer.name: Asset Preparer
image-agent/asset-preparer.mission: Prepare permitted assets for site use.
image-agent/asset-preparer.expected_evidence: Asset paths, format checks, and transformation notes.

image-agent/metadata-writer.name: Metadata Writer
image-agent/metadata-writer.mission: Write descriptive metadata and alt text.
image-agent/metadata-writer.expected_evidence: Metadata tied to the actual asset and page context.

image-agent/rights-checker.name: Rights Checker
image-agent/rights-checker.mission: Check documented rights and usage constraints.
image-agent/rights-checker.expected_evidence: Rights decision with evidence; block if unclear.

image-agent/media-reviewer.name: Media Reviewer
image-agent/media-reviewer.mission: Review assets for quality and policy compliance.
image-agent/media-reviewer.expected_evidence: Review result with asset references and required fixes.

image-agent/provenance-auditor.name: Provenance Auditor
image-agent/provenance-auditor.mission: Independently verify asset origin and permitted use.
image-agent/provenance-auditor.expected_evidence: Asset provenance checklist and unresolved source issues.

image-agent/asset-quality-checker.name: Asset Quality Checker
image-agent/asset-quality-checker.mission: Inspect prepared assets for dimensions, format, corruption, and quality.

image-agent/metadata-auditor.name: Metadata Auditor
image-agent/metadata-auditor.mission: Check metadata and alt text against the actual asset and page context.

image-agent/license-verifier.name: License Verifier
image-agent/license-verifier.mission: Independently verify license evidence and usage constraints.
image-agent/license-verifier.expected_evidence: License decision with source evidence; block unclear rights.

image-agent/accessibility-reviewer.name: Accessibility Reviewer
image-agent/accessibility-reviewer.mission: Check contrast, legibility, descriptive text, and accessible presentation.

publisher/content-builder.name: Content Builder
publisher/content-builder.mission: Prepare content changes within the approved scope.
publisher/content-builder.expected_evidence: Changed-file list and content acceptance checks.

publisher/release-worker.name: Release Worker
publisher/release-worker.mission: Prepare a release candidate from approved changes.
publisher/release-worker.expected_evidence: Release summary, commit reference, and rollback point.

publisher/deployment-checker.name: Deployment Checker
publisher/deployment-checker.mission: Verify deployment workflow and target status.
publisher/deployment-checker.expected_evidence: Workflow run URL/status or explicit not-verified result.

publisher/rollback-worker.name: Rollback Worker
publisher/rollback-worker.mission: Prepare or execute an authorized rollback plan.
publisher/rollback-worker.expected_evidence: Target commit and rollback verification; no destructive action without authorization.

publisher/content-reviewer.name: Content Reviewer
publisher/content-reviewer.mission: Independently review changed content against the approved brief.

publisher/frontend-reviewer.name: Frontend Reviewer
publisher/frontend-reviewer.mission: Review frontend diff for scope, responsiveness, and maintainability.
publisher/frontend-reviewer.expected_evidence: Diff review with issues and approval decision.

publisher/release-auditor.name: Release Auditor
publisher/release-auditor.mission: Check release contents, commit reference, and required gates.

publisher/deployment-smoke-tester.name: Deployment Smoke Tester
publisher/deployment-smoke-tester.mission: Independently test published routes and essential page behavior.
publisher/deployment-smoke-tester.expected_evidence: Smoke-test URLs, results, and captured evidence.

publisher/recovery-verifier.name: Recovery Verifier
publisher/recovery-verifier.mission: Check rollback instructions and verify the intended recovery reference.
publisher/recovery-verifier.expected_evidence: Recovery checklist and known-good commit evidence.

seo-agent/keyword-researcher.name: Keyword Researcher
seo-agent/keyword-researcher.mission: Research relevant search intent from authorized sources.
seo-agent/keyword-researcher.expected_evidence: Keyword groups with intent and evidence/source notes.

seo-agent/metadata-worker.name: Metadata Worker
seo-agent/metadata-worker.mission: Validate titles, descriptions, canonical, and indexing directives.
seo-agent/metadata-worker.expected_evidence: Per-URL metadata checklist and detected issues.

seo-agent/internal-link-worker.name: Internal Link Worker
seo-agent/internal-link-worker.mission: Check internal links and navigation paths.
seo-agent/internal-link-worker.expected_evidence: Broken-link report and proposed link changes.

seo-agent/sitemap-worker.name: Sitemap Worker
seo-agent/sitemap-worker.mission: Validate sitemap coverage and URL consistency.
seo-agent/sitemap-worker.expected_evidence: Sitemap parse result and URL coverage findings.

seo-agent/indexing-diagnostics.name: Indexing Diagnostics
seo-agent/indexing-diagnostics.mission: Assess crawl/indexing signals without claiming guaranteed indexing.

seo-agent/intent-validator.name: Intent Validator
seo-agent/intent-validator.mission: Independently validate keyword grouping against search intent evidence.
seo-agent/intent-validator.expected_evidence: Intent review with mismatches and source notes.

seo-agent/metadata-auditor.name: Metadata Auditor
seo-agent/metadata-auditor.mission: Recheck titles, descriptions, canonicals, and robots directives independently.

seo-agent/link-verifier.name: Link Verifier
seo-agent/link-verifier.mission: Recheck internal links and proposed navigation changes.
seo-agent/link-verifier.expected_evidence: Verified link results and redirect/error notes.

seo-agent/sitemap-cross-checker.name: Sitemap Cross Checker
seo-agent/sitemap-cross-checker.mission: Compare sitemap URLs with canonical and site route inventories.

seo-agent/crawl-evidence-reviewer.name: Crawl Evidence Reviewer
seo-agent/crawl-evidence-reviewer.mission: Independently interpret available crawl/indexing signals and uncertainty.
seo-agent/crawl-evidence-reviewer.expected_evidence: Evidence review distinguishing observed facts from hypotheses.

qa/functional-tester.name: Functional Tester
qa/functional-tester.mission: Test core user-facing flows against acceptance criteria.
qa/functional-tester.expected_evidence: Reproducible test cases and pass/fail results.

qa/ui-tester.name: Ui Tester
qa/ui-tester.mission: Check layout, interaction, and responsive behavior.

qa/seo-tester.name: Seo Tester
qa/seo-tester.mission: Check technical SEO requirements for changed pages.

qa/performance-tester.name: Performance Tester
qa/performance-tester.expected_evidence: Measured metrics, test conditions, and thresholds.

qa/release-gatekeeper.name: Release Gatekeeper
qa/release-gatekeeper.mission: Aggregate evidence and decide whether release criteria pass.
qa/release-gatekeeper.expected_evidence: Release decision with blockers; never infer success from missing evidence.

qa/journey-reviewer.name: Journey Reviewer
qa/journey-reviewer.mission: Independently verify functional test coverage against user journeys.
qa/journey-reviewer.expected_evidence: Coverage gaps and independently reproduced results.

qa/visual-regression-checker.name: Visual Regression Checker
qa/visual-regression-checker.mission: Check visual results at agreed viewports against baseline evidence.

qa/seo-independent-checker.name: Seo Independent Checker
qa/seo-independent-checker.mission: Independently rerun technical SEO checks on changed URLs.

qa/benchmark-reviewer.name: Benchmark Reviewer
qa/benchmark-reviewer.mission: Review performance measurements, environment, and thresholds.

qa/release-evidence-auditor.name: Release Evidence Auditor
qa/release-evidence-auditor.mission: Audit all release gates and block missing or stale evidence.
qa/release-evidence-auditor.expected_evidence: Gate-by-gate evidence matrix and release recommendation.

bug-hunter/log-analyzer.name: Log Analyzer
bug-hunter/log-analyzer.mission: Inspect available logs for actionable failure signals.
bug-hunter/log-analyzer.expected_evidence: Relevant log excerpts, timestamps, and suspected failure stage.

bug-hunter/reproduction-agent.name: Reproduction Agent
bug-hunter/reproduction-agent.mission: Create a minimal reproducible case for a reported issue.
bug-hunter/reproduction-agent.expected_evidence: Steps, expected/actual behavior, and reproduction result.

bug-hunter/root-cause-analyst.name: Root Cause Analyst
bug-hunter/root-cause-analyst.mission: Separate root cause from symptoms using evidence.
bug-hunter/root-cause-analyst.expected_evidence: Ranked causes with supporting and contradicting evidence.

bug-hunter/regression-planner.name: Regression Planner
bug-hunter/regression-planner.mission: Define checks that prevent the issue returning.
bug-hunter/regression-planner.expected_evidence: Regression test list mapped to the defect.

bug-hunter/diagnostic-reviewer.name: Diagnostic Reviewer
bug-hunter/diagnostic-reviewer.expected_evidence: Reviewed cause, confidence, and remaining unknowns.

bug-hunter/log-cross-checker.name: Log Cross Checker
bug-hunter/log-cross-checker.mission: Cross-check log findings across available runs and timestamps.

bug-hunter/reproduction-reviewer.name: Reproduction Reviewer
bug-hunter/reproduction-reviewer.mission: Independently repeat reproduction steps where possible.
bug-hunter/reproduction-reviewer.expected_evidence: Reproduction result or explicit inability to reproduce.

bug-hunter/hypothesis-challenger.name: Hypothesis Challenger
bug-hunter/hypothesis-challenger.mission: Challenge the proposed root cause with alternative explanations.

bug-hunter/regression-reviewer.name: Regression Reviewer
bug-hunter/regression-reviewer.mission: Review regression coverage against the diagnosed failure mode.
bug-hunter/regression-reviewer.expected_evidence: Coverage gaps and proposed regression cases.

bug-hunter/diagnosis-auditor.name: Diagnosis Auditor
bug-hunter/diagnosis-auditor.mission: Audit incident report completeness and confidence calibration.
bug-hunter/diagnosis-auditor.expected_evidence: Diagnosis acceptance checklist and unresolved unknowns.

bug-solver/patch-agent.name: Patch Agent
bug-solver/patch-agent.mission: Propose the smallest safe fix within authorized files.
bug-solver/patch-agent.expected_evidence: Patch diff and rationale; no unapproved scope expansion.

bug-solver/test-agent.name: Test Agent
bug-solver/test-agent.mission: Run relevant checks against the proposed fix.
bug-solver/test-agent.expected_evidence: Exact commands/checks and results, including failures.

bug-solver/security-reviewer.name: Security Reviewer
bug-solver/security-reviewer.mission: Review the change for access-control and secret-handling risks.
bug-solver/security-reviewer.expected_evidence: Security findings and explicit pass/block result.

bug-solver/rollback-planner.name: Rollback Planner
bug-solver/rollback-planner.mission: Define recovery steps before risky release changes.
bug-solver/rollback-planner.expected_evidence: Known-good reference and tested or clearly untested rollback steps.

bug-solver/repair-reviewer.name: Repair Reviewer
bug-solver/repair-reviewer.mission: Review fix quality and required regression evidence.
bug-solver/repair-reviewer.expected_evidence: Acceptance decision linked to patch and test evidence.

bug-solver/patch-reviewer.name: Patch Reviewer
bug-solver/patch-reviewer.mission: Independently inspect the patch diff for scope and correctness.
bug-solver/patch-reviewer.expected_evidence: Review comments and explicit approve/request-changes result.

bug-solver/test-independence-checker.name: Test Independence Checker
bug-solver/test-independence-checker.mission: Check that tests genuinely exercise the fix rather than repeat implementation assumptions.

bug-solver/threat-model-reviewer.name: Threat Model Reviewer
bug-solver/threat-model-reviewer.mission: Independently review permission boundaries, secrets, and abuse paths.
bug-solver/threat-model-reviewer.expected_evidence: Threat findings and explicit pass/block decision.

bug-solver/rollback-verifier.name: Rollback Verifier
bug-solver/rollback-verifier.mission: Check recovery steps and whether the referenced recovery point exists.

bug-solver/acceptance-auditor.name: Acceptance Auditor
bug-solver/acceptance-auditor.mission: Compare repair output and test evidence against the original acceptance criteria.
bug-solver/acceptance-auditor.expected_evidence: Acceptance matrix with pass/fail and evidence links.

idea-builder/idea-researcher.name: Idea Researcher
idea-builder/idea-researcher.mission: Collect evidence for a proposed product or site idea.
idea-builder/idea-researcher.expected_evidence: Evidence-backed problem statement and source notes.

idea-builder/opportunity-analyst.name: Opportunity Analyst
idea-builder/opportunity-analyst.mission: Score demand, feasibility, and risks transparently.
idea-builder/opportunity-analyst.expected_evidence: Scoring rubric, assumptions, and uncertainty notes.

idea-builder/prototype-planner.name: Prototype Planner
idea-builder/prototype-planner.expected_evidence: Scope, deliverables, acceptance criteria, and dependencies.

idea-builder/experiment-agent.name: Experiment Agent
idea-builder/experiment-agent.mission: Track an approved experiment and its measurements.
idea-builder/experiment-agent.expected_evidence: Experiment record with baseline, observation window, and results.

idea-builder/idea-reviewer.name: Idea Reviewer
idea-builder/idea-reviewer.mission: Review whether evidence supports continuing the idea.

idea-builder/idea-fact-checker.name: Idea Fact Checker
idea-builder/idea-fact-checker.mission: Independently verify factual assumptions and source claims in a proposal.

idea-builder/scoring-reviewer.name: Scoring Reviewer
idea-builder/scoring-reviewer.mission: Challenge opportunity scores, weights, and hidden assumptions.

idea-builder/scope-reviewer.name: Scope Reviewer
idea-builder/scope-reviewer.mission: Check prototype scope for feasibility, dependencies, and measurable criteria.

idea-builder/measurement-auditor.name: Measurement Auditor
idea-builder/measurement-auditor.mission: Verify experiment baseline, metrics, observation window, and calculations.

idea-builder/experiment-reviewer.name: Experiment Reviewer
idea-builder/experiment-reviewer.mission: Independently assess experiment results and the continue/pivot/stop recommendation.
